summary: Setup scripts sign in reliably, and Invardia can spot slow jobs sooner.

new.title: Invardia sees addresses and job durations
new.text: For installs that report to Invardia, the status report now includes the web app's addresses and how long a running job has taken compared with usual.

new.title: Every admin script on invardia.com
new.text: Every script an admin runs is now available on invardia.com as one self-contained file, checked against the release before it runs.

fixes.title: Setup scripts sign in fresh each time
fixes.text: The mail, web access and alert setup scripts now sign in again on a second run, instead of reusing an expired sign-in or one for another tenant.
